description: A distributor tracks how much of each item is in each of its warehouses.

entities.name: Warehouse
entities.description: A place where goods are kept.

entities.name: Movement
entities.description: Goods coming in, going out or moving between warehouses.

fields.name: warehouse_id
fields.description: where the goods arrive (receive) or leave from (ship, transfer)

fields.name: to_warehouse_id
fields.description: the destination warehouse; only for a transfer

endpoints.summary: Record goods received, shipped or transferred
What a warehouse holds: [{"item_id": int, "sku": str, "quantity": int}]
How much of an item there is: {"item_id": int, "total": int, "by_warehouse": [{"warehouse_id": int, "quantity": int}]}

rules: kind must be receive, ship or transfer; anything else is rejected with 422.
quantity must be at least 1; reject with 422.
receive adds the quantity of the item to warehouse_id. ship removes it from warehouse_id; shipping more than that warehouse holds of the item returns 409 and changes nothing.

transfer moves the quantity from warehouse_id to to_warehouse_id. For a transfer, to_warehouse_id is required and must be different from warehouse_id (otherwise 422) and must refer to an existing warehouse (otherwise 404). Transferring more than warehouse_id holds of the item returns 409 and changes nothing.
GET /warehouses/{id}/stock returns a JSON list with one object (item_id, sku, quantity) for each item the warehouse holds more than 0 of. An unknown warehouse returns 404.

GET /items/{id}/stock returns a JSON object with item_id, total (the quantity over all warehouses) and by_warehouse, a list with one object (warehouse_id, quantity) for each warehouse that holds more than 0 of the item. An unknown item returns 404.
item_id and warehouse_id must refer to existing records; otherwise 404.
